subject: Capacity safeguard recon: Peregrine Labs late-stage sizing
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2029 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity safeguard recon: Peregrine Labs late-stage sizing

Team —

Peregrine Labs (inline below) is asking us to confirm dedicated capacity sizing for a GA scope. This is an urgent late-stage ask tied to their Q4 launch and our commercial close. High level: they want a dedicated pool, p99 latency target ~200ms for conversational LLM features, expected sustained throughput ~5 reqs/sec with bursts up to 20 reqs/sec, context windows up to 8k, beam-ish sampling in some flows.

Could infra ops (Karthik/Ben) run a quick availability and suggestion note for what to hold now (soft hold window + length) vs. what we’d recommend for pilot -> GA? Please call out: GPU type equivalents (A100/H100), node counts, expected concurrency per node, and any constraints if we try to reserve across regions.

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW and a quick capacity worksheet (capacity_matrix_q3.xlsx) — use that if helpful.

Ask: can you return a short recommendation and an internal soft-hold ask we can (a) present to the customer and (b) push into capacity as a provisional reservation?

Thanks — need this by EOD Monday (24th) ideally so we can lock the mutual action plan.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity safeguard recon: Peregrine Labs late-stage sizing

Stephanie —

Quick availability and recommendation based on the workload notes:

Summary (short):
- Immediate recommendation: place a provisional soft-hold for 12 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 for 30 days (ticket CAP-8731). That covers pilot -> early GA headroom while we finalize SOW.
- Pilot sizing: 4x A100-80GB nodes (dedicated pool) should handle the initial pilot (5 rps sustained, bursts to 20) when running optimized quantized weights and with prefix/KV caching.
- GA baseline: recommend scaling to 12x A100-80GB equivalent (or 8x H100-80GB if customer requires faster p99/throughput and we can convert to H100 inventory).

Rationale and constraints:
- We estimate ~3.5 concurrent requests per A100 node at the 8k context target with a p99 ~200ms if the model is quantized to 4-bit and batching is allowed. If they run unquantized 16-bit weights, throughput per node drops ~40% and latency rises — in that case recommend H100s.
- Current free inventory (us-west-2): ~18 free A100-80GB-equivalent slots and ~6 free H100-80GB slots over the next 60 days (subject to new commitments).
- Cross-region reservations are possible, but if Peregrine requires single-region residency we should mark that explicitly.

Operational ask for sales:
- If you want the provisional soft-hold, confirm the hold window (we suggest 30 days) and whether Region = us-west-2 is acceptable. Once you confirm we will open CAP-8731 and flag those nodes as provisional reserve (non-billable hold).
- We’ll also include a short runbook describing the rollback and fallback policy (model variant fallback to a smaller quantized profile).

Next steps:
- If you confirm the 30-day soft-hold for 12 A100-equivalents, I’ll create the reservation ticket and push to capacity ops.
- We can also schedule a 30m sync with Peregrine to align on model quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Ben: FYI on availability numbers — please add if you see any different scheduling constraints for July.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra Lead, Serving & Capacity | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: capacity_matrix_q3.xlsx (updated with node mapping and rough throughput numbers)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Capacity safeguard recon: Peregrine Labs late-stage sizing

Caitlin / team —

Thanks for the call last week. Internal ops ran a quick availability check and recommended the following provisional approach so we don’t lose runway while the SOW is finalized:

- Provisional soft-hold: 12 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 for 30 days (we will extend if contract terms justify).
- Pilot footprint we’ll build against: 4 A100 nodes (pilot), ramping to 12 A100-equivalents for GA. If Peregrine prefers H100s for GA we can swap but that may affect lead times.

We want to confirm if Peregrine is comfortable with us reserving in us-west-2 and a 30-day soft-hold window. If yes, we’ll raise the internal reservation ticket this morning and follow up with a short runbook and handoff.

Also attaching the draft SOW (for context) — please flag anything that would change the sizing assumptions (model size, quantization plan, SLA).

Best —
Stephanie
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Thanks, Stephanie and team.

Peregrine confirms we are comfortable with a provisional soft-hold for 30 days in us-west-2 while we finalize SOW and procurement. Please proceed to open the internal reservation ticket and share the CAP number so our procurement team can reference it during PO review.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you include an explicit fallback if H100 inventory becomes constrained (e.g., auto-fallback to quantified A100 variant + performance budget)?
2) We’d like a weekly 15-min sync starting next Tuesday to track SOW/procurement and the capacity ticket.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to getting the ticket reference.
